overview_description.description:
Simple. Spending. Software.

Penny is a cloud-based procure-to-pay system. Penny helps you digitize and manage your full procurement cycle from request to approval. Manage RFQs to vendors, compare quotations, send POs and even payment. penny was designed to make things easy and consolidate all of your organization’s spending needs into one intelligent system

about_short_description.short_description: Procure to Pay & Spend Management Software

product.name: Penny Source-to-Pay Platform
product.description: A cloud-based procurement platform that manages the purchasing lifecycle from purchase requests and sourcing through approvals, purchase orders, receiving, invoicing, budget control, and payments.

product.name: B2B E-commerce as a Platform
product.description: A white-label B2B commerce platform that connects clients and suppliers and supports RFQs, offer management, catalogs, approvals, vendor administration, and configurable commissions or markups.

product.name: Procurement as a Service
product.description: A managed procurement service that provides operational and strategic support for sourcing, supplier engagement, procurement workflows, and spend-related activities.

product.name: Local Content Tracker
product.description: A Saudi-focused platform for calculating and monitoring local content performance across goods and services, labor, capacity building, and depreciation and amortization.

product.name: Bidly.ai
product.description: An AI sourcing tool for automating parts of RFQ and procurement event execution, including supplier communication, offer evaluation, and sourcing analysis.
